recommendedSharedComposition.geometry: One compact square landscape vignette: a single simple house at right on a low green foreground, two rolling hills across a fixed horizon, two small low bushes, and a contained rounded sky silhouette. Fixed camera, house design/size/position, hill contours, horizon and footprint across every variant; real transparent exterior and gaps.
changeOnly: small motion cue where needed to distinguish sunrise from evening
recommendedSharedComposition.sunrise: Sun rising across same horizon, short upward cue and optional faint earlier sun position; fresh pale dawn lighting. No separate second landscape scene.
recommendedSharedComposition.earlyEvening: Sun near same horizon with short descending cue and optional faint earlier position; warm sunset sky and beginning window light. Emphasize evening transition, not a new landscape.
recommendedSharedComposition.night: Same scene/camera at night, sun absent, small moon and few stars, deep violet sky and gentle window glow; no motion arrow.
recommendedSharedComposition.referenceRecommendation: Use the already approved night house/contained-sky illustration as an identity/style reference, and existing夕方v1 low-hill/house layout as optional geometry reference. Establish one consistent base and derive the three variants with minimal edits. Do not assume prior night approval accepts a revised night version.
recommendedSharedComposition.futureCompatibility: This stable landscape supports future morning/noon/daytime variants if those words are later added; do not create nonexistent catalog cards now.
